# PlayRates

> PlayRates (https://playrates.app) is a video game tracker. People log the games they play, one log per platform, with a status (playing, played, backlog or wishlist), how a played game ended (finished, mastered, retired or shelved), hours played, a rating out of 10 and a written review. They follow friends and talk about games in community threads.

Every game, public profile and community thread has its own page, and each page carries its content as plain HTML, so it can be read without running the app.

- Game ratings are averages of PlayRates members' own ratings, out of 10, with the number of ratings beside them.
- "Logged" counts every log, so one person playing on two consoles counts twice.
- Average hours played and to beat come from members' logs.
- Critic scores, release dates, platforms, genres and descriptions come from IGDB.
- Private profiles and spoiler reviews are kept out of what the site shows to anyone not allowed to see them.

## Pages

- [Library](https://playrates.app/library): every game in the catalogue, searchable, sortable by most logged, rating, critic score and release date.
- [Community](https://playrates.app/community): threads about the games people here are playing.

Each game, profile and thread is at an address of its own, all listed in the sitemap:

- Games, `https://playrates.app/game/{id}`: the game's facts, the PlayRates rating, average hours and recent reviews.
- Profiles, `https://playrates.app/user/{username}`: a member's bio and recent reviews, unless the profile is private.
- Threads, `https://playrates.app/community/thread/{id}`: the opening post and its replies.

- [Sitemap](https://playrates.app/sitemap.xml): every game, thread and fixed page.
